context: A chef and barista plan an outdoor-themed event
purpose: Teach: 風力/天文/観劇/醍醐味/大自然/骨董/アトラクション/カトリック教

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 葵さん、屋外イベント、風力発電の見学ツアー、組まんか。
lines.en: Aoi-san, want to put together an outdoor event? There's a wind-power plant tour.
lines.style: Warm, bright opening—like proposing something he's genuinely excited about. Kansai lilt on the question lift. Energetic but not pushy. Leaning forward slightly.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: はい。天文台観測ナイト、企画しましょう。
lines.en: Yeah, I'd love to. We could organize an observatory night for it.
lines.style: Soft agreement with genuine interest underneath. Quiet—not performing enthusiasm, already turning the idea over in her mind. Thoughtful pace. Eyes brightening as she speaks.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 観劇とコラボのコース料理、ええなあ。
lines.en: A theater collaboration with a special course menu—that would be really nice.
lines.style: Knowing warmth. Like he's watching her warm to the idea and enjoying it. Light Kansai texture. Conversational, not lecturing. Almost conspiratorial agreement.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 地元食材の醍醐味、お客様に伝えます。
lines.en: I'll make sure the guests really understand what makes local ingredients special.
lines.style: Brightening resolve. Gentle but clear intention—she's already visualizing it. Not rushed. A small smile in the voice. Pride in the work without boasting.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 大自然系のドリンク、ハーブで作ろ。
lines.en: For the drinks, let's make something wild-feeling—herb-based, you know?
lines.style: Practical energy. Hands-on, already problem-solving. Kansai casual rhythm. Not overthinking—this is the kind of thing he loves to build. Confident without strain.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 店の小物、骨董の市で仕入れます。
lines.en: I'll source some special pieces from the antique market for the shop's decor.
lines.style: Cheerful nod-along. She's keeping pace with his ideas and adding her own. Light, capable tone. Not agreeing passively—genuinely invested. Soft but present.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: アトラクション付きのカフェ夜営業、ええで。
lines.en: A late-night cafe with attractions and all—that would really work.
lines.style: Animated, building excitement. Kansai warmth and generosity in the cadence. Like the shape of the whole thing is becoming clear to him now. Genuine approval, genuine energy.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: カトリック教徒の常連様にも、配慮した別メニュー、用意します。
lines.en: And I'll make sure to prepare a separate menu for our Catholic regulars too—so everyone feels included.
lines.style: Warm close. Thoughtful attention to detail said simply, without self-congratulation. Soft, steady voice. This is kindness as a natural action, not a performance. Small pause before speaking, settling into care.
